---
name: "Challenge a claim / 质疑一项主张"
about: "Raise a precise mathematical, formalization, scope, interpretation, or reproducibility concern."
title: "[Challenge] "
---

Thank you for scrutinizing the research. You do not need to evaluate the whole programme; one precise concern is enough.

感谢你审查这项研究。无需评价整个研究纲领；指出一项具体问题即可。

### Type / 问题类型

- [ ] Mathematical definition or proof / 数学定义或证明
- [ ] Lean formalization or dependency / Lean 形式化或依赖
- [ ] Scope or overclaim / 主张范围或过度推断
- [ ] Counterexample or alternative model / 反例或替代模型
- [ ] Philosophical interpretation / 哲学解释
- [ ] Reproduction or website issue / 复现或网站问题
- [ ] Other / 其他

### Claim ID or location / 主张编号或位置

<!-- e.g. theorem name, page URL, section, equation, file path -->

### Claim as understood / 我理解的原主张

<!-- State the claim you are questioning, as precisely as possible. -->

### Objection or question / 具体质疑或问题

<!-- What do you think is wrong, missing, ambiguous, or too strong? -->

### Evidence, counterexample, or reproduction steps / 证据、反例或复现步骤

<!-- Include equations, references, logs, or a minimal example if available. -->

### Suggested resolution / 建议的处理方式

- [ ] Correct the claim / 更正主张
- [ ] Add an assumption / 补充前提
- [ ] Narrow the scope / 缩小适用范围
- [ ] Mark unresolved / 标记为未解决
- [ ] I am mainly asking a question / 主要是提问

### Additional notes / 其他说明

<!-- Please do not include passwords, credentials, private information, or data you are not authorized to share. Issues are public. -->
